paragraphs: Hi, I'm **Miro** and I create websites and web applications. I handle the whole process from visual design and the user interface to the backend and a working website.

With an eye for detail, I combine colors, shapes, code, and empty space into a whole that works well, looks pleasant, and feels natural to use. I enjoy finding calm in complexity and bringing the essential parts forward.
I work with React on the frontend and Python and its web frameworks on the backend. You can explore my work in the [projects section](/projects)

contact.intro: I will be glad to hear from you with a question, an idea, or a specific request. If you are looking for someone to build a website, an app, or improve an existing solution, feel free to write. Together we can go through what you need and what the next step should be.
